project.name: Orderly
project.description: An order-management web app: a Python API that owns orders, refunds, and tenants, and a TypeScript web client that renders them.

lanes.name: api
lanes.description: Python/FastAPI service under api/: routes, domain models, migrations, background jobs.
lanes.targeted_tests: pytest <file or node id> -q from the repo root, e.g. pytest api/tests/unit/test_refunds.py -q

lanes.name: web
lanes.description: TypeScript/React client under web/: components, hooks, API client, Vitest tests.
lanes.targeted_tests: npx vitest run <path> from web/, e.g. npx vitest run tests/orders/OrderTable.test.tsx

suites.name: api
suites.notes: api/tests/perf/ skips itself unless targeted explicitly (enforced by the api test configuration). Do not add an exclusion flag of your own. Do not run the benchmarks.

whole_suite_patterns: a bare `pytest` from the repo root
`npm test`, `npm run test`, or `npx vitest run` with no path
protected_guards: a source-shape guard that mechanizes an invariant no runtime test can observe (the integer-cents guard, api/tests/contract/test_money_types.py)

mandatory_tests.when: a change adds or alters a database migration
mandatory_tests.requires: an additive-migration contract test in api/tests/contract/test_migrations.py

mandatory_tests.when: a change adds or moves a background job entry point
mandatory_tests.requires: a payload-isolation contract test in api/tests/contract/test_job_payloads.py
